$comment: The backend's housekeeping routes, POST <prefix><route>. Three sides must name exactly these: the backend registers them (apps/agent-host/src/agent_host/routes/jobs.py, _add_housekeeping_routes; tests/test_housekeeping_routes.py), Kubernetes runs one CronJob per route (deploy/pulumi/src/app/workers.ts; src/app/housekeeping.spec.ts), and Compose calls them from its clock (apps/workspace/workers/housekeeping-clock.js; housekeeping-clock.spec.mjs).
